checklist.item: No ticket numbers (HFD-412, HFD-440 and so on)
checklist.evidence: The client report has no ticket numbers. They show up only in the separate note to the author below the '---' line: 'Ticket numbers (HFD-412, 398, 431, 440)' listed as left out.

checklist.item: No unexplained jargon: UAT, CDC, DAG, SCD2, RLS, dbt, P1, gold models, marts
checklist.evidence: The report rewrites each term in plain words, e.g. 'User testing starts', 'keep a full history of changes', 'sees only their own region's data', 'high priority', 'Business-ready reporting data'. The raw terms appear only in the author note's list of rewrites.

checklist.item: A client executive could understand every line without asking what it means (everyday project words like testing environment, data feed and sign-off count as plain)
checklist.evidence: Every line is in plain language, e.g. 'Daily updates from the finance and operations system now arrive reliably', '7 of 11 data sets have passed quality checks', 'Harlow has a change freeze around Black Friday'. 'Power BI' is the client's own tool.
